lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a regular geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular clusters, creating high-contrast nodes within the flank pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal ridge feature located in the upper third of the flank, defined by a high-intensity highlight on the superior edge and a dark shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or tissue loss is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remora fish silhouettes are attached to the ventral surface and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
